Ceiling = wc -l package/contents/ui/SyncEngine.qml | SyncEngine.qml 5698 -> 5806, 2026-09-20 late, for three defects met on one evening, each reproduced before it was touched. A Bluetooth speaker came up a dead pipe after every login: five builds out of five the group was built in silence, the birth flush bounced the transport 1.2 s later, and nothing reached the air once the music started; three builds with the bounce taken out were three live speakers. The flush is now owed in silence and paid once under flowing music, where it was harmless four times. The knock budget rides QML timers, which stand still while the machine sleeps: a station that goes quiet at eleven with the lid closed a minute later still had knocks left at eight, and the network's return replayed it — a radio starting on its own nine hours late, under the release that promised it could not. The relay road could also leave the order standing with no ladder under it. And the 600 ms bitrate fallback was the one recovery that never asked whether the room was parked. The lines are the stamp, the question at the door, the two guards, and why.
